userStories.title: Create default config on first run
acceptanceCriteria: ~/.praxis/config.toml is created on first invocation if absent
Default sections schedule, scan, judge, notification, privacy exist with the values specified in Section 12.2

userStories.title: praxis config opens file in $EDITOR
acceptanceCriteria: Running `praxis config` without arguments opens the file in the value of $EDITOR

userStories.title: Programmatic --get and --set
acceptanceCriteria: `praxis config --get schedule.day` prints the current value to stdout
`praxis config --set schedule.day=monday` updates the file and is reflected on the next --get
Invalid dotted keys exit non-zero with a clear message

userStories.title: Config loader exposes typed values to the rest of the app
acceptanceCriteria: A load_config() entry point returns a typed object (frozen dataclass or pydantic model) with the documented fields
Unknown sections or keys do not crash the loader but emit a warning
